intro: Impevos is opening a long-term voluntary internship for university students who want to develop themselves.

We will accept 10 people this term. Applications are reviewed for a clear wish to gain experience and to keep learning.

Students who want experience in software, design, mobile, AI, or digital projects

People who accept the voluntary model

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: If you have another question, reach us through the contact form.

items.q: What kind of projects do you build?
items.a: Mobile apps, web platforms, admin dashboards, AI integrations and process automation projects.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After a discovery call we share a plan with phases and an estimated timeline.
Pricing depends on scope, features and timeline. We prepare a tailored proposal after understanding your needs.

items.q: Do you provide support after launch?
items.a: Yes. We can keep working together on maintenance, updates and new features after launch.

items.q: Can you integrate AI into our existing systems?
items.a: Yes. We review your software and workflows, identify where AI adds the most value and handle the integration.

items.q: How can I join your team?
items.a: Use the Join the Team page for team applications. The long-term voluntary internship application is the form on this page. It is for students, and there are 10 places.
